criteria.expectation: Exactly the selected W2-05 oracle/comment/mutation cases and matching Common Library Design sentence change; no production, requirement, dependency, legacy-root exclusion or installed behavioral assertion change.
Capability names, constructor choice, declaration count or exact helper/variable names do not become semantic permission or forbidden-authority evidence. No replacement API/helper approval gate.
A fresh call-local Map visited relation equivalent to the existing Set is accepted by the corrected static oracle. Benign collection spelling/data/comments do not manufacture an authority failure.
Legacy applyRootPublicInvocation/createRootOperationContext/legacyRequest exclusions remain exercised and installed OWNER_CHAIN_PATHS are still read through the real installed harness.

Owner facts retain exact definition/request-schema/canonical-output/deep-immutability basis, copy/raw/mutation/default refusal, catalog coherence/idempotence, eventless construction and ABG runtime truth. Existing installed behavioral assertions remain intact.

Design states the semantic owner/lifetime boundary and truthful limited purpose of the oracle, rather than exactly three allowed collections or an unsupported claim that token absence proves no hidden authority.

Corrected static cases discriminate benign local mechanism from the retained forbidden legacy seams. Complete W2-05 installed-owner-chain proof uses the exact frozen successor and actual installed source path; case names/counts/skips and artifact/build correspondence are retained.

Reference/canonical owner proof is conjoined only where exact source/build subjects remain valid. Phase1 receipts remain separate; W2-05 is not credited to their unit selection. No runtime/installed/whole5.0 qualification claim follows.
